_note: Week of July 27–August 2, 2026. Budget, land-meat comfort food — ground beef, ground sausage, ground turkey, and chicken carry the whole week, no fish or shellfish anywhere (Laine's tuna lunch jar is the one exception, since canned tuna is a cheap pantry staple rather than the pricey fresh stuff). The week's standalone sauce card is a Cheddar Cheese Sauce — built to work through a good chunk of the cheddar on hand, which also shows up shredded on five of the seven dinners, Jake's lunch bowl, and Laine's Tue/Thu/Sat breakfast scramble. Monday's ground beef skillet makes extra for Tuesday's standing Pita Tuesday (chopped-cheese style, ground sausage as the treat protein). Wed and Fri move off their usual fish slot onto chicken. Saturday is vegetarian (loaded cheddar potatoes). Sunday is standing breakfast-for-dinner, a sausage-potato-cheddar skillet using the back half of Friday's sausage. No raw onion, mushrooms, lentils, okra, or eggplant anywhere; no reheated chicken in Laine's lunch; red meat stays to one beef night (plus its Tuesday leftovers).

tzatziki.name: Cheddar Cheese Sauce
tzatziki.note: Jake's tzatziki slot, cheddar-ified — a basic roux-based cheese sauce sized to blanket Wednesday's chicken and rice, with extra left over to spoon onto the chili, the loaded potatoes, or anything else that wants it later in the week. Makes about 2¼ cups (9 servings of ¼ cup), keeps 4–5 days — reheat gently with a splash of milk, it thickens a lot in the fridge.

ingredients.item: Cumin, paprika, garlic powder, salt — 1 tsp

steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in the flour and cook 1 min, stirring, until it smells toasty (this is your roux).
Whisk in the milk gradually, a splash at a time at first, until smooth. Simmer, whisking often, 4–5 min until it thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon.
Take off the heat. Stir in the cheddar a handful at a time until fully melted and smooth — off-heat keeps it from breaking.
Whisk in the Dijon and spices. Season with black pepper. Keep warm until serving; reheat leftovers low and slow with a splash of milk.

dinners.name: Cheddar Beef & Potato Skillet
dinners.note: One pan, budget-friendly, and not a fish night so it doesn't touch the Monday rule anyway. Extra beef gets browned alongside for Tuesday's leftovers — buy accordingly.

ingredients.item: Ground beef 85/15 — Jake 200g, Laine 115g raw (buy ~320g extra for Tuesday)
Yellow onion — Jake ⅓ cup, Laine ¼ cup, diced
Cheddar cheese, shredded — Jake ⅓ cup, Laine ¼ cup
Diced tomatoes (canned) — Jake ⅓ cup, Laine ¼ cup
Worcestershire sauce — Jake 1.5 tsp, Laine 1 tsp
Dijon mustard — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp
Olive oil — Jake ½ tbsp, Laine ⅓ tbsp

steps: Dice the potatoes small (½-inch) so they cook fast. Pan-fry in the olive oil over medium-high, 8–10 min, until golden and fork-tender. Set aside.
In the same pan, brown the ground beef with the onion and garlic, breaking it up as it cooks. Season with the spice mix.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, Worcestershire, and Dijon. Simmer 2–3 min. Fold the potatoes back in.
Top with cheddar, cover, and let it melt, 2 min. Jake gets the bigger portion. Cook a little extra beef on the side and set it aside, unseasoned with the tomato mix, for Tuesday.

dinners.name: Chopped Cheese Pitas
dinners.note: Standing leftovers-plus-a-treat night. Monday's plain reserved beef gets crisped back up with a treat of ground sausage crumbled in for extra flavor, piled into warm pita with melted cheddar, lettuce, and tomato — bodega chopped-cheese energy.

ingredients.item: Reserved ground beef from Monday — Jake 120g, Laine 80g
Ground sausage (treat protein) — Jake 60g, Laine 35g raw
Yellow onion — Jake ¼ cup, Laine scant ¼ cup, diced small
Cheddar cheese, shredded — Jake ⅓ cup, Laine ¼ cup
Whole wheat pita — Jake 1, Laine ¾
Olive oil — Jake ½ tbsp, Laine ⅓ tbsp

steps: Crumble the ground sausage into a hot skillet with the olive oil. Cook through, 4–5 min.
Add the reserved beef and onion. Cook, chopping everything smaller with your spatula (that's the "chopped cheese" bit), until crisp at the edges. Season with the spice mix.
Scatter cheddar over the meat, cover briefly until melted.
Warm the pitas. Split and fill with the meat and cheese, top with romaine and cherry tomato. Jake gets the bigger pita and more filling.

dinners.name: Cheesy Chicken, Broccoli & Rice Skillet
dinners.note: Off the usual fish slot this week — seared chicken and broccoli over rice, finished with a ladle of the week's cheddar sauce instead. Classic combo, budget protein.

ingredients.item: Cheddar Cheese Sauce — Jake ¼ cup, Laine 3 tbsp (see recipe card)

steps: Cook the rice. Steam or blanch the broccoli until just bright green and tender-crisp.
Season the chicken with the spice mix and garlic. Sear in a hot pan 6–7 min per side until cooked through (165°F). Rest 5 min, then slice.
Plate rice, chicken, and broccoli together.
Warm the cheddar sauce if needed and ladle over the top. Jake gets more chicken and a bigger pour of sauce.

dinners.name: Ground Turkey & Black Bean Chili
dinners.note: Free night, filled with a quick stovetop chili — lean ground turkey does most of the work, beans kept modest so the protein isn't diluted. Topped with cheddar and a spoon of sour cream.

ingredients.item: Black beans — Jake scant ⅓ can, Laine ¼ can, rinsed
Diced tomatoes (canned) — Jake ⅔ cup, Laine scant ½ cup
Yellow onion — Jake ¼ cup, Laine scant ¼ cup, diced
Cheddar cheese, shredded — Jake ¼ cup, Laine 3 tbsp, for topping
Daisy sour cream — Jake 1.5 tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Cumin, paprika, garlic powder, salt — generous 2 tsp

steps: Brown the turkey with the onion and garlic, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, black beans, and spices. Simmer 15 min, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Ladle into bowls. Top with cheddar and a dollop of sour cream. Jake gets the bigger bowl.

dinners.name: Cajun Sausage & Chicken Skillet
dinners.note: Also off the fish slot this week. A little ground sausage carries the Cajun flavor while chicken does the protein heavy-lifting, over rice with peppers and beans. No cheese tonight — not every dish needs it. Buy enough sausage to also cover Sunday's skillet.

ingredients.item: Ground sausage — Jake 80g, Laine 50g raw (buy extra for Sunday)
Chicken breast — Jake 160g, Laine 90g raw, cubed
Yellow onion — Jake ¼ cup, Laine scant ¼ cup
Diced tomatoes (canned) — Jake ⅓ cup, Laine ¼ cup
Pinto beans — Jake ⅛ can, Laine scant ⅛ can, rinsed

steps: Cook the rice separately. Brown the sausage in a skillet, breaking it up, then remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sear the cubed chicken until just cooked through. Add peppers, onion, and garlic, cook 4–5 min.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, pinto beans, spices, and the sausage. Simmer 8–10 min until it comes together.
Serve over rice. Jake gets more of everything.

dinners.name: Loaded Cheddar & Black Bean Baked Potatoes
dinners.note: Vegetarian night. Baked potatoes loaded with black beans, cheddar, and broccoli — Greek yogurt stands in for sour cream on top for extra protein without much extra fat.

ingredients.item: Russet potato — Jake 200g (2 medium), Laine 200g (2 medium)
Black beans — Jake ⅓ can, Laine ¼ can, warmed
Cheddar cheese, shredded — Jake ½ cup, Laine ⅓ cup
Greek yogurt (plain nonfat) — Jake ~1.5 tbsp, Laine ~1 tbsp, in place of sour cream

steps: Bake the potatoes at 400°F for 45–50 min (or microwave 8–10 min) until tender all the way through.
Steam the broccoli. Warm the black beans with a pinch of the spice mix.
Split the potatoes, fluff the inside a bit with a fork. Load with black beans, broccoli, and cheddar.
Top with a dollop of Greek yogurt. Jake gets the bigger potatoes and more topping.

dinners.name: Sausage, Potato & Cheddar Breakfast Skillet
dinners.note: Standing breakfast-for-dinner — doesn't have to be waffles, and isn't tonight. The back half of Friday's sausage, potato, eggs, and cheddar in one skillet.

ingredients.item: Ground sausage (reserved from Friday) — Jake 115g, Laine 65g
Russet potato — Jake 120g, Laine 90g, diced small
Liquid egg whites — Jake ½ cup, Laine ⅓ cup
Cheddar cheese, shredded — Jake ⅜ cup, Laine ⅓ cup
Yellow onion — Jake ¼ cup, Laine scant ¼ cup

steps: Pan-fry the diced potato over medium-high in a dry nonstick skillet (the sausage will render its own fat soon), 8–10 min until golden.
Add the sausage, onion, bell pepper, and garlic. Cook, breaking up the sausage, until browned through.
Push everything to one side. Beat the eggs and egg whites together, pour into the cleared space, scramble gently until just set, then fold together with the rest.
Scatter cheddar over the top, cover 1–2 min until melted. Jake gets the bigger portion.

jakeLunch.name: Cheddar Ranch Chicken & Rice Bowl
jakeLunch.note: Sunday-batch, 5 containers, no fish (office-friendly), reheats fine — reheated chicken is no problem for Jake. Rice and chicken batch-cooked together, black beans and cheddar keep it from being boring.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — ~3 lbs total (250g raw per container)
Black beans — ~⅛ can per container, rinsed
Cheddar cheese, shredded — ⅓ cup per container

steps: Cook all the rice at once. Season chicken with the spice mix and sear/grill in batches, ~6–7 min per side until 165°F. Rest, then dice.
Warm the frozen veggies through, rinse the black beans.
Divide into 5 containers: rice, chicken, veggies, black beans, cheddar on top.
Reheats well all week — that's the point.

laineLunch.name: Cold Tuna & Black Bean Mason Jar
laineLunch.note: Standing cold format — unchanged this week, since canned tuna is a cheap pantry staple rather than the pricier fresh-fish stuff this week is steering away from. Avocado added fresh at the table so it doesn't brown in the jar.
laineLunch.dressingNote: Olive oil + lemon juice, ~1 tbsp oil + ½ tbsp lemon juice per jar, kept separate and added just before eating.

ingredients.item: Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans total)
Black beans — ~¼ can per jar, rinsed
Avocado — ½ avocado per jar, added fresh when eating
Olive oil — 1 tbsp per jar (dressing, separate)
Lemon juice — ½ tbsp per jar

steps: Drain tuna, rinse black beans. Dice cucumber and bell pepper.
Layer each jar: black beans → tuna → cucumber → bell pepper.
Portion the olive oil + lemon juice dressing into a small separate container per jar.
To eat: add dressing and fresh-cut avocado, stir, eat straight from the jar.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl. Top with thawed berries and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Cheddar & Veggie Egg White Scramble
laineBreakfasts.note: Swapped the usual feta for cheddar this week — one more small dent in the surplus.

ingredients.item: Pinch cumin, paprika, garlic powder, salt

steps: Sauté cherry tomatoes 1–2 min in a dry nonstick pan until they start to soften.
Add egg whites, scramble over medium-low until just set.
Toss in spinach at the end. Top with cheddar and a pinch of spice mix.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Waffles + Berries
laineBreakfasts.note: Standing Sunday-morning waffles — separate from Sunday's breakfast-for-dinner, unchanged as always.

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake/waffle mix — ½ cup dry

steps: Mix batter: mix + egg whites + water per package. Stir in flaxseed.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron 3–4 min until crisp.
Top with thawed berries.

laineSnacks.name: Banana + Greek Yogurt
laineSnacks.desc: 1 banana + 1 Oikos Triple Zero. Potassium + calcium snack.

laineSnacks.name: Cucumber + Hummus
laineSnacks.desc: ¾ cucumber sliced + hummus for dipping.

laineSnacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas
laineSnacks.desc: ¼ cup crunchy roasted chickpeas. Fiber + plant protein, lightly spiced.

laineSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Berries
laineSnacks.desc: 1 Oikos Triple Zero + small handful thawed berries.

jakeSnacks.name: Apple & Cheddar
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 apple, sliced, with cheddar. Simple, and another dent in the surplus.

ingredients.item: Cheddar cheese, shredded — ⅓ cup (or a sliced chunk)

jakeSnacks.name: Cottage Cheese + Banana
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 cup cottage cheese + 1 banana. High protein, calcium + potassium.

jakeSnacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas + Almonds
jakeSnacks.desc: ¼ cup roasted chickpeas + a small handful of almonds.

jakeSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Almonds
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 container plain Greek yogurt + a small handful of almonds. High-protein pick.

Must Buy: Ground beef 85/15 — ~1.25 lbs (Monday skillet + Tuesday leftovers)
Ground sausage (bulk, breakfast or Italian style) — ~1 lb (split across Tue treat / Fri / Sun)
Chicken breast — ~4.25 lbs (Wed + Fri dinners, plus Jake's 5-container lunch batch)
Bell peppers — 2–3 (Fri, Sun, Laine's lunch jars)
Canned tuna in water — 5 cans (Laine's lunch jars)
Black beans — 3 cans (Thu, Sat, both lunches)
Pinto beans — 1 can (only need ¼, rest keeps)
Broccoli florets — 1 bag, fresh or frozen (Wed + Sat)
Check Supply: Yellow onion — 1–2, used most nights in small amounts
Garlic — check you have a good bulb left, used almost every night
Butter, all-purpose flour — for the cheddar sauce roux
Whole milk — for the cheddar sauce
Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard — small amounts, should still have some from past weeks
Daisy sour cream — small container, only needed for Thursday
Greek yogurt (plain nonfat) — 1 tub (Saturday topping + Jake's snack)
Oikos Triple Zero — 6+ containers (Laine's breakfasts + snacks)
Liquid egg whites — 1 carton (Sunday dinner + breakfasts)
Hummus, roasted chickpeas, almonds, cottage cheese — snack staples
Lemon juice — small bottle (Laine's lunch dressing)
Cumin / paprika / garlic powder / oregano / thyme — restock the spice tin if low
Already Have: Cheddar cheese, shredded — this is the week that uses it up: roughly 6–6.5 cups total across the sauce, five dinners, Jake's lunch, and Laine's breakfast scramble. Should make a real dent in the surplus — only top up if you're running low partway through.
Olive oil — check the bottle is at least half full
